run_id.description: Scratchpad run directory name. Defaults to active thread_id or task_id (creates the directory if missing).

scope.description: Optional human-readable audit scope stored in inventory.json

areas.description: Inventory rows (default: one pending area for workspace root)

template.description: When set to workspace_audit, auto-build inventory from workspace Cargo.toml members (includes runtime-server, desktop web-ui areas). Ignores default single-row inventory.
